spans.s:
Stukā denotes a ‘tuft’ of hair or wool in the Rigveda^1 and
later.^2
1) ix. 97, 17.
2) Kāṭhaka Saṃhitā, xxv. 6; Av.
vii. 74, 2; Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, iii. 2,
1, 13, etc.

Stuti in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 denotes a ‘song of praise.’
1) i. 84, 2; vi. 34, 1; x. 31, 5.
2) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, vii. 5, 2, 39

Stūpa in the Rigveda^1 and later^2 denotes the ‘top-knot’ of
hair as designating the upper part of the head.
1) vii. 2, 1. Cf. i. 24, 7.
2) Taittirīya Saṃhitā, iii. 3, 6, 5; Pañcaviṃśa Brāhmaṇa, xiii. 4, 4.
